findings.title: iOS: no guard against a second concurrent gesture; second-finger tap fires unintended smartMove and clears in-flight drag
findings.failure_scenario: Finger A mid-drag on head X; finger B taps head Y. Y's onEnded runs smartMove(Y) and drag=nil; A snaps back, then A re-creates drag(X) and can still drop X -> two moves from one drag.
findings.rationale: onEnded tap branch calls smartMove unconditionally + drag=nil with no drag?.source==spot check; @State drag is single-valued. CONFIRMED no guard; manifestation SUSPECTED (needs device). Recoverable via undo.
findings.suggested_fix: onEnded: return early unless drag==nil||drag?.source==spot; onChanged: only create DragInfo when drag==nil.

status_history.validation: guard drag==nil||source==spot verified on all 4 paths; onChanged unchanged; no new swallow.

findings.title: iOS: drag state can stick non-nil if dragged view is torn down mid-drag by in-flight autoplay
findings.failure_scenario: Drag a tableau top card while a prior autoplay chain ticks; a step sends it home, destroying the view. If SwiftUI cancels without onEnded, drag stays set -> column stuck at elevated zIndex.
findings.rationale: drag only cleared in onEnded; no board-mutation observer resets it. No corruption, purely stuck visual layering. SUSPECTED.
findings.suggested_fix: Reset drag=nil via .onChange(of: game.moveCount) or when drag.source no longer indexes a live card.

status_history.validation: dragSourceHoldsCard bounds-safe; autoplay mutates before moveCount++; drop sets drag=nil synchronously first; no wrong-cancel.

findings.title: Dead code from selection removal: CardView.selected and web .card.sel unreachable
findings.failure_scenario: No runtime failure; misleading residue implying a selection highlight that no longer exists.
findings.rationale: All CardView call sites dropped selected:; default false never true; .card.sel never applied after isSelected removal. CONFIRMED via grep.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete CardView.selected and its uses; delete the .card.sel CSS rule.

status_history.validation: param+overlay+CSS removed; grep clean; call sites use card:width: only; selectedCards untouched.

findings.title: iOS: successful drop may visually jump (.offset snaps to zero simultaneously with matchedGeometryEffect)
findings.failure_scenario: On legal drop the model relocates via matchedGeometryEffect while drag=nil zeroes runOffset in the same withAnimation; card may jump finger->old slot->glide to dest.
findings.rationale: .offset is render-time, not reflected in matched-geometry source frame; two animations don't compose. Web avoids via FLIP. Cosmetic; SUSPECTED.
findings.suggested_fix: Position drag via matchedGeometry-friendly means, or delay clearing drag until matched transition completes.

status_history.validation: only a BACKLOG entry added; no rendering change; cosmetic deferral accepted.
